- last_name: TEXT
- email: TEXT
- position: TEXT

SELECT LENGTH(e.expense_date) AS date_length,
       TYPEOF(e.cost) AS cost_type,
       COUNT(*) AS expense_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Vice President' THEN 1 END) AS vice_president_expense_count,
       MAX(CASE WHEN m.position = 'Vice President' THEN e.expense_date END) AS latest_vice_president_expense,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.expense_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS non_iso_date_count
FROM expense AS e
LEFT JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY LENGTH(e.expense_date), TYPEOF(e.cost)

arguments.sql:
WITH latest_vice_president_expense AS (
    SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT e.expense_date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN latest_vice_president_expense AS latest
    ON latest.expense_date = e.expense_date
GROUP BY e.expense_date
LIMIT 1
